Boots category: 81 items over 3 pages, $130–$430, no markdowns. Names: 1460 Smooth Leather Lace Up Boots $180, 2976 Chelsea $180, Jadon platforms $210, Combs Tech MK.02 $130, 1460 and 2976 Vintage Made In England $280, Rick Owens Steel Toe Boots $430 (https://www.drmartens.com/us/en/unisex/boots/c/04010000?page=2).

1460 product page: $180, upper 100% leather, sole 100% PVC, grooved air-cushioned sole; US women's 5–12, men's 6–14 with 15 and 16 listed as notify-me; 'Free shipping on orders $50+' (https://www.drmartens.com/us/en/1460-smooth-leather-lace-up-boots-black/p/11822006).

Size guide: if between sizes it's better a little bigger than too small, and an insole can take up half a size; men's and unisex styles are wider with a rounder toe, women's narrower (https://www.drmartens.com/us/en/about/size-guide).
Terms: free shipping on orders of $50 or more to a single US address; prices valid only in the United States (https://www.drmartens.com/us/en/terms-conditions).

Dr. Martens plc: the first boot was born on 1 April 1960 in Wollaston, England, hence '1460'; HQ 28 Jamestown Rd, Camden, London; registered in England and Wales (https://drmartensplc.com/our-business).
